note: Both sets extract the same two unique values (pitch sensitivity at theta=0 and theta_k) but duplicate them with different entities/attributes, leading to redundancy in both. Both sets fail to capture the subscript 'k' in the quotes for theta_k (quoting 'θ =' instead of 'θk ='), and both have one claim with a truncated unit ('watt/ra' instead of 'watt/rad'). Set A structures the condition for sensitivity slightly better (in the conditions field vs attribute name), but Set B is otherwise identical in accuracy and errors.
